parsed.explanation: Parent regime remains the ceiling: federal passports are issued only by sex assigned at birth, entry officers are instructed to refuse and investigate discrepancy/doubt and can consider fraud ineligibility, federal facilities are barred by gender identity, and national custody policies mandate birth-sex/conversion practices with documented abuse. No general criminalisation of trans presentation and courts are actively contesting these measures. The state adds real local protections: anti-discrimination and hate-crime coverage since 1993, X driver's licences without documentation, marker changes without surgery, repeal of the sodomy statute, and a 2023 gender-affirming-care shield, placing it in the most-protective tier. Custody evidence is a dated 2012 birth-sex placement and assault, and enforcement data for local protections are unsourced, so paper protections are not fully credited as operating remedies.
